question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Punctual
solution:
The correct answer is: **Late**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Punctual **means being on time or prompt. (समय पर या शीघ्र होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Sarah is always punctual for her meetings, never keeping anyone waiting.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Late **is the opposite of punctual and means arriving after the expected or desired time. (अपेक्षित या वांछि
